title: Long-term variability of air quality and greenhouse gas emissions from rice crop burning in Punjab during 2012–2020

Punjab, India's main rice-producing state, has seen rapid expansion of paddy cultivation over past two decades, driven by monsoon-aligned sowing, adoption of high-yielding varieties, minimum support price incentives and shifts in government policy.
